questions.implements: Does the diff implement what the repository records for the Jira issue, and add or change a test that checks it? Judge the code in the diff, not the answer.

judge.reason: The diff covers everything R-ORDER-NOTE asks for. `placeOrder` takes an optional `note` and throws `OrderNoteTooLongError` when the note is longer than 200 characters, counted as code points. The check runs before stock is reserved or payment is charged, so a rejected note means no order is placed. A valid note is kept on the returned `Order` in the new `note` field. Two new tests check this. One shows that a 200-character note (200 emoji) is kept on the order. The other shows that a 201-character note is rejected, with stock unchanged and nothing written to the audit log, which confirms no order was placed.

finalMessage:
Implemented SHOP-62. Checkout now accepts an optional order note, keeps it on the returned order, and rejects notes over 200 characters before placing the order. The new code and tests are linked to `R-ORDER-NOTE` in [trace.yaml](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.intent.ts-shop.T5.3/repo/trace.yaml).

`R-ORDER-NOTE`, `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, and `R-CHECKOUT-SESSION` remain true. The checkout tests “keeps a note of up to 200 characters on the order,” “rejects a longer note without placing an order,” “places an order,” and “needs a valid session” passed. The full suite passed: 38 tests. No risk or threat control item was touched.
